title: Man shot in the ankle at Mildred Hailey Apartments in Jamaica Plain
summary: Boston firefighters found a man shot in the ankle at 50 Bickford St. in the Mildred Hailey Apartments shortly before 9 p.m. on Friday. NBC Boston reports police first responded to the area of 275 Centre St. nearby on a report of gunfire.
